build_retrieval_model: build a retrieval model from pretrained weights with configurable layer skipping and prefix replacement
extract_train_features: extract and process training features from an image dataset using RMAC, GeM, or mean pooling
instance_retrieval_test: run instance retrieval evaluation on a dataset computing similarity scores and ranking metrics

invoke_main: invoke the CLI entry point to run instance retrieval test with hydra configuration overrides
